rationale: Selected the smallest catalog cable passing all three checks: 50mm² fails ampacity (147.46A < 180A) and voltage drop (7.51% > 5%); 70mm² passes ampacity (188.93A) but fails voltage drop (5.40% > 5%); 95mm² passes all checks with derated ampacity 228.86A, voltage drop 4.08%, and exceeds minimum thermal section 53.07mm².
